meta.write: leftover close as an a priori
meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. A leftover close is a knob on the check. It does not write X.

lemmas.name: B35_close_readable
lemmas.statement: finer-box miss, finer-DNS miss, and the leftover catalog are readable together
lemmas.why: B22e and B23e are scored. The leftover knobs missed. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B35a_close_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: a leftover close writes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: A catalog of fails is not continuation. Leftover knobs are knobs on the check. They do not write X.

lemmas.name: B35b_catalog_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: scoring B14d through B23e is a continuation argument for classical X
lemmas.why: Continuation is an estimate, not a list of missed slogans. The field still has no bound.

lemmas.name: B35c_fails_not_ns
lemmas.statement: a stack of leftover fails is still an NS a priori
lemmas.why: Failing a knob is not sitting the packet. Do not promote a catalog to a type.

lemmas.name: B35d_close_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: leftover closes are an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: A leftover close is a knob on the check. It is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. Beale still asks for the max.

lemmas.name: B35e_domain_leftover
lemmas.statement: classical regularity is decided by leftover closes
lemmas.why: The leftover knobs are scored. The leftover is the object: a closed estimate for X. Domain B stays open.

lemmas.name: B35f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring leftover closes as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. Leftover closes are knobs on the check. No Q1. No ε. Do not type c=8 into the equation. Do not spawn n=64.
